findings.message: `ClusterAdapter` has exactly one implementation (`ClusterAdapterWithHeartbeat`)
findings.evidence: This abstract class is implemented only by `ClusterAdapterWithHeartbeat` repo-wide, with no test double. Until a second implementation exists, `ClusterAdapterWithHeartbeat` can be used directly.
